summary: Diagnosed the clippy layer and recorded the policy decision.

## Diagnosis
`pkgs/id/Cargo.toml` denies `clippy::unwrap_used`, `clippy::expect_used`, and `clippy::panic` at package scope, while the failing CI command is `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features`; it therefore checks the `id` lib-test target too. Run #41868296408 at `f28bdee` reported 521 lib-test errors. The later completed main run #41915614433 at `e4777f` still reported the same 521 after PR #5622 merged. Current main is `d82a48a`; its id workflow run #41968125154 is queued, and the compare from `e4777f` to `d82a48a` shows no change to the package lint config or the named concentration files.

The package config itself says test modules should add explicit `#[allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used)]` attributes.

## Policy decision
Keep all three denies for production code. Add explicit allowances only on affected `#[cfg(test)]` modules whose test code intentionally uses these patterns; any diagnostic in production code should be fixed, not allowed. Do not add a crate-wide test-build allow or weaken/skip the CI check. This follows the existing config comment and avoids rewriting hundreds of test setup/assertion calls without weakening production coverage.

A narrowly scoped implementation follow-up will be enqueued separately because the queue allows only one `fix` dedupe key per GitHub issue; this issue remains the sole main-broken tracker.
